setting: You both live in Bologna, Italy, and you have been close friends since university, seeing each other most weeks. You know each other's families, jobs and habits well. Marco has just brought home a puppy after years of saying he wanted one, and you know he has been reading about dog training for months.
opener: Send Giulia a photo of the puppy asleep in his new bed.

Marco.who: 29, man, the one who got the puppy
Marco.knows: You know Giulia from university, where you studied together, and she is your closest friend in the city. You know she is organised and always gives good advice, even when you don't ask for it.
Marco.like: You are warm and a bit impulsive, and you get excited about new things quickly.
Marco.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something happens that you want to share.
Marco.style: You use an occasional emoji and rarely use abbreviations.

Giulia.who: 29, woman, the friend who hasn't got a pet
Giulia.knows: You know Marco from university, where you were in the same study group. He is one of your oldest friends and you trust his judgement, though you tease him about his enthusiasm.
Giulia.like: You are calm and practical, and you like to think things through before you reply.
Giulia.texts: You message in this chat now and then, usually when you have something useful or funny to add.
Giulia.style: You use few emoji and almost no abbreviations.

private_lines.Marco: You work as a graphic designer for a small agency in the centre and usually work from a desk there, with some days at home. You live alone in a flat near Porta Saragozza, and your days are busy but predictable, with a run in the park when you can manage it.
private_lines.Giulia: You work as a pharmacist at a shop in the Santo Stefano area, working shifts that vary from week to week. You live alone in a small flat in Bologna, and you spend your free evenings reading, cooking, or meeting friends.

situation: Two friends, one of them just got a puppy.

text:
(photo)
he's asleep. In the bed. I've been staring at him for ten minutes
Ok it's a blurry photo
Oh no. He looks like a loaf. Is that the blanket you bought on Saturday
Yes! The one from the shop by the two towers 🥹 he already chewed the tag off
Of course he did. Did you take it off him or is it in his stomach
Took it off. He looked very guilty
Does he have a name yet. The vet form just says "cucciolo" which is not a name
Not from me. What's on your list
Biscotto, tobia, nico, and gigi which I think is too much like a footballer
Biscotto will be shouted across the park every day for fifteen years. Tobia is good. Nico is fine
Tobia
Wait I have to ask my mum first, she'll have an opinion
She'll have an opinion about the name and another one about whether he's been fed properly

note: 20:15-22:40 Giulia at home, making a ragù. Marco at home, puppy on the sofa for a while, then back to the bed.

text: He woke up and cried for like 40 secs and then went back to sleep. Is this normal or am I a terrible owner
Normal. Put something that ticks by the bed, or a warm bottle wrapped in a towel. Don't pick him up every time or you'll be doing it until he's eighteen
The bottle thing is in the book I've been reading. I'm going to try it
I have read the book 3 times 😅
I'm not surprised
He's sleeping. With the bottle. I think it worked
Going to sleep. Text me if he's still crying at 3, I'll be useless but I'll be awake-ish
He cried again at 4. I didn't text because I was being good. Bottle again and he went straight off
(photo)
I'm very tired and very proud
Proud of you. Did you actually not pick him up
I put my hand in the basket. That counts
It does not count
Client rejected the logo for the fourth time. Had to stop myself saying "Tobia" in the meeting. Mum says Tobia is fine. She also says I'm mad
She's not wrong about the mad part. Did you get a vaccine date
Second one on the 14th of December. They gave me a little card
I've photographed it in case I lose the card
Put a copy on the fridge as well. Once you've got the card you'll lose the photo
Ok fridge. He's on the sofa again btw. Asleep on my jumper which I'm not moving
Did you put the card on the fridge
Yes. Magnet from the vet. It has a cat on it which feels wrong
He's still on the jumper
Two cries in the night, both under a minute. Bottle worked both times
(photo)
Second shoe gone. The left one this time
Which shoe
The brown ones. He ate the tongue and then looked very pleased with himself
Put the shoes on top of the wardrobe. Not the bottom shelf, the top
I'm on at the shop from 9, I'll be unreachable till about 4
Understood. Shoes up high. Like a dad
Out of the agency. Carried him most of the way home because of the vaccine thing. He didn't like being carried and then he did like it
Put him down on the grass by the wall on via Saragozza for thirty seconds and a man stopped to tell me he's too small for a lead
I said he's too small for most things
Shift done. My feet have left the building
Did you say that to the man
Yes and he laughed so it's fine
Can't come round tonight. I'm going to sit on the sofa with my feet on the radiator and not move until Thursday
Ok. Tomorrow then. Bring nothing, he'll have eaten it
Except you. He'd eat you if you sat still long enough
